Looking back, the "MG02 | OSLinux-OSLinux_LOCALDISK_LOCALDISK-sdb_DSKReadWrite" is a critical metric. High disk I/O can lead to bottlenecks, especially if the disk is shared among multiple services. But wait, the "MG02 | OSLinux-OSLinux_LOCALDISK_LOCALDISK-sdb_DSKReadWrite" is a direct disk metric. If that's peaking at 1256.0, that's a lot.
